subject: executor: try to optimize index hash join query by reduce cop task count (#54841)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff: IndexNestedLoopHashJoin now seeds the outerWorker batch size from the first output chunk’s RequiredRows (capped by `tidb_index_join_batch_size`) to reduce lookup/coprocessor task count. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/concurrency; `RequiredRows()` and `IndexJoinBatchSize` are both constrained to be >= 1 (chunk construction + sysvar MinValue), so the new initialization doesn’t create a zero-batch starvation path. Upstream/master retains this logic (no later fix indicating a latent high-severity bug).
